newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN EDMILSON JOINS PSG FROM PORTO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN EDMILSON JOINS PSG FROM PORTO.

text.p: Brazilian forward Edmilson joined Paris St Germain from Portuguese champions Porto for about 20 million francs ($3.5 million) on Tuesday.

Edmilson, who signed a three-year contract and underwent a medical check before club training, became PSG's eighth recruit for a season in which their priority is the league championship they last won in 1994.
Part of the deal involves Daniel Kenedy, a Portuguese defender who joined PSG from Benfica a year ago, moving in the other direction to Porto.
Edmilson is the sixth Brazilian to join the French team since Ricardo, their current manager, Geraldao and Valdo in 1991.

Midfielders Rai, who joined PSG in 1993, and last season's recruit Leonardo are on the clubs books at present although the Brazil national team playmaker is still being linked with either AC Milan or Barcelona.
